description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between recent sequence ratio and perplexity, as well as recent sequence ratio and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Perplexity” and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. 

A solid orange line with circular markers represents “Perplexity”, starting at approximately 4.63 when the recent sequence ratio is 0, decreasing to a minimum of approximately 4.32 at a recent sequence ratio of 60, and then increasing to approximately 4.61 at a recent sequence ratio of 100. A dashed brown line represents “Full Cache PPL”, remaining relatively constant at approximately 4.52 across the entire x-axis range. A solid blue line with circular markers represents “GPU Mem. Ratio”, starting at approximately 42 when the recent sequence ratio is 0, increasing to approximately 48 at a recent sequence ratio of 60, and then rising sharply to approximately 94 at a recent sequence ratio of 100. A dashed teal line represents “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, starting at approximately 85 when the recent sequence ratio is 0 and decreasing to approximately 48 at a recent sequence ratio of 100.
